A '''fusion disk''' was a small device which had a small charge attached to it. When the disk made contact with another surface, the charge ignited, causing the disk to fuse itself<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|299|fusion disk}}</ref> to any metallic surface. Fusion disks were used by [[power harpoon launcher]]s to allow [[Spacetug/Legends|tugs]] and [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] to two cargo modules and [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> 

[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Beryl Chiffonage]] devised a tactic that was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to trip the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] that utilized tow cables attached to fusion disks.<ref name="CSWE" />
